subject.title: Gateway memory growth due to repeated file read errors

question: Should the remaining fix target the scheduled producer/prompt that requests CORE.md and agent-tasks paths, or should OpenClaw change generic read-tool semantics for directory and missing-memory reads?
rationale: Current main already fixed adjacent slices, but the remaining source evidence is split between an unidentified scheduled producer and a broad model-facing read-tool contract change that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Fix Producer First
options.body: Trace and fix the scheduler or prompt path that emits stale memory-system and directory read requests while keeping read-tool semantics stable.

options.title: Change Read Semantics
options.body: Make the read tool return directory listings or soft failures for selected paths, accepting a broader contract change with tests and docs.

options.title: Fold Into OOM Umbrella
options.body: If maintainers decide the read failures are only incidental, link this issue to the broader gateway memory tracker and preserve the log evidence there.

recommendation.title: Fix Producer First
recommendation.body: Trace and fix the scheduler or prompt path that emits stale memory-system and directory read requests while keeping read-tool semantics stable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent cron/read-resilience work and session-store cleanup commits make this the best available routing signal for the behavior-boundary decision.
